description: MP-20, free-coordinate decoder, 100 epochs: the baseline the symmetry decoder is compared with.
config_text:
# MEIDNet on MP-20 (45,229 Materials Project structures <= 20 atoms, 89 elements, 6,282 prototypes, general inorganic
# chemistry rather than perovskites).  The first dataset above the decoder's density threshold: 817 distinct compositions
# per element against the 200 the density rule requires, so block S0 predicts GENERATION for the first time.
# mp20_main: seed 0, structure-only losses 1.0.  Benchmark splits kept as published.
name: mp20_main
description: "mp20_main: MP-20, site_order roles, cgcnn descriptors, periodic encoder, max_sites 20"
output_dir: /gpfs/scratch/acad/catalys/ababu/meidnet_fix/runs/mp20_main/out
data:
  table: /gpfs/scratch/acad/catalys/ababu/meidnet_data/mp20/intake/train.csv
  val_table: /gpfs/scratch/acad/catalys/ababu/meidnet_data/mp20/intake/val.csv
  id_column: material_id
  cif_column: cif
  properties:
    - {column: formation_energy_per_atom, label: Formation energy, unit: eV/atom, normalize: true}
    - {column: band_gap, label: Band gap, unit: eV, normalize: true}
  max_sites: 20
  site_order: roles
  align_to_prototype: false
model:
  decoder_coordinate_input: zeros
  periodic_encoder: true
  element_features: cgcnn
training:
  epochs: 100
  batch_size: 128
  learning_rate: 0.001
  seed: 0
  device: cuda
  save_every: 20
  loss_weights: {structure_reconstruction: 1.0, structure_property: 1.0}
